known_information: The reporter supplies exact Run Program/Focus app shortcuts, successful Chrome/Code activation and a persistent Default IME not-responding dialog.

The supplied ZIP and actual Keyboard Manager remap/engine log coverage were inspected. The November2 engine log contains195focus-path trace markers, including fallback FindWindow show-all attempts across multiple Code processes; no Default IME text or TSF deadlock stack was found in those engine logs.

Current TryShowExistingProgram first selects a visible ownerless window; its fallback enumerates target-process windows with nonempty titles and calls ShowWindow/SetForegroundWindow. A title alone does not prove an eligible app main window.
